We connect candidates with the most attractive employers in Romania. Below you can find a selection of jobs from top companies in Romania.
What we are looking for Were looking for a proactive and technically curious DevOps Engineer with strong Linux, scripting, cloud, networking, and database skills. Youll bring a customer-focused mindset, sound analytical and troubleshooting abilities, and the confidence to work independently while collaborating effectively with others. What you will be doing Key contributor, willing to go the extra mile to achieve desired results Be accountable for operations and administration of service platforms Real time analysis of faults and customer tickets, drive corrective actions in accordance with customer impact; perform emergency recovery actions Monitor performance parameters for services and platforms, initiate escalation process (including vendor) in case of detection of service or performance degradation Perform and drive preventative maintenance, triggers corrective actions Involvement and contributor on the build and integration activities Contribute to the launch of new services -> bringing into operations, checking current operations, platform configuration Coordinate / getting involved during the implementation of high-risk changes including network upgrade activities, software upgrades and infrastructure parameter changes, maintaining the quality of service and avoiding platform dysfunctionalities Automate service monitoring and different operational tasks to reduce circles in process Document temporary and permanent fixes that were deployed Develop different types of reports to monitor business evolution Participate in internal and external training sessions in order to raise technical skills Train/support new colleagues in Operations when needed On-call duty. What you need to know   Technical knowledge Strong Linux knowledge with system and network parameters, scripting with bash/python/ansible Devops Tools (ElasticSearch, Grafana, Prometheus, Git, Jenkins, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Openshift) Cloud technology Network concepts: switching, load balancing, routing, firewalls, IPs, DNS Web applications middleware: Apache, Ngnix, Tomcat, Proxy Generic database admin and sql/nosql knowledge (MariaDB, MongoDB,RedisDB,Oracle, PostgreSQL) Fluent in English; French will be a plus Autonomous with good capability for teamwork Solid interpersonal skills Technical curiosity Synthesis skills Whats in it for you Performance Bonuses - based on your results & the companys Electronic Meal Tickets Medical & Life insurance for you - facilities for your family, too Professional GSM subscription Personal GSM subscription, also [because we believe in communication!] Special grants on Smartphones & devices; discounts for Orange products & services Development Platforms - Orange Learning, Trainings, Career Counselling, Coaching & Career plan mentoring Wellbeing Programs - we support your Zen
